learning_objective.title: Route live lab-awareness objectives to MIM runtime execution instead of TOD bounded code implementation
learning_objective.lesson: A lab sensor/camera/TTS objective is not a code patch request. MIM must classify it as MIM-owned runtime execution, produce sensor/action evidence, and only use TOD/Codex for monitoring, guidance, or blocked-with-inspection escalation.
recurrence_guard: If objective_id starts with MIM-LAB-AWARENESS, do not require changed_files as success evidence.
Do not route camera/TTS/human-presence execution through TOD bounded edit gates.
If TOD trigger ack is stale, repair the bridge, but continue to keep the lab objective active.
Completion requires live lab evidence, not implementation validation.

guidance_to_mim.corrective_route: Treat MIM-LAB-AWARENESS-HUMAN-INTERACTION-V1 as a MIM-owned runtime objective.
guidance_to_mim.next_mim_action: Publish MIM_LAB_AWARENESS_STATUS.latest.json naming the current phase, current blocker if any, and the next MIM-owned runtime action.
guidance_to_mim.bridge_repair_action: Recover TOD_TO_MIM_TRIGGER_ACK freshness only as coordination repair; do not let bridge repair replace the lab objective.
guidance_to_mim.success_gate: Do not claim success until every lab-awareness acceptance criterion has a fresh evidence artifact.

tod_supervision.next_monitor_check: verify whether MIM publishes MIM_LAB_AWARENESS_STATUS.latest.json or fresh trigger ack for the lab task
